newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said there would be a special meeting on social dialogue in The Hague on June 6. He said the results of the negotiations on part-time work would be presented to the European social partners, Commission President Jacques Santer, Commissioner Padraig Flynn and Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok.
Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori briefed on the Court of Justice judgments.
In answer to a question spokesman Peter Guilford said the EU was close to reaching a non-binding bilateral agreement with Australia.

Spokesman Patrick Child said the EU Finance Ministers, Commission President Santer and Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy would attend a dinner on Sunday night, preceding the ECOFIN Council to discuss, notably, the euro coins design.

Guilford said the EU was close to reaching a Mutual Recognition Agreement (MRA) with the United States. Guilford also said the U.S. had backed down on some parts of the pre-agreement, which the Commission could not accept.

Asked to react to a report on a cooperative joint venture between the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company (P&0) and Stena line AB of Sweden spokesman Willy Helin said it had been notified to the Commission but no decision had been taken yet.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/480: Rare diseases: European Commission proposes a Community action programme.
- IP/97/486: EU and Guinea-Bissau sign a new protocol to their fisheries agreement.
- IP/97/489: World Environment Day.
- IP/97/490: Standards for trucks used for animal transport approved.
- IP/97/491: Social dialogue: high level restricted meeting in The Hague, June 6, 1997.
- IP/97/492: Commission supports urban renewal in Helsinki.
- IP/97/493: The European Commission invites the International Group of P&I Clubs to increase competition between its members.
- IP/97/494: The Commisssion approves the acquisition of the sole control by Worms & Cie of the group Saint-Louis.
- Speech/97/131: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler at European Dairy Association General Assembly.
- Speech/97/132: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on "The challenge of a wider Europe".
- Speech/97/133: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on "European policy in wine sector".
- Speech/97/134: Speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan at the Marshall Plan commemorative ceremony.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Energy and Industry No 1997-13: Continuing recovery in the production of hot rolled steel products in the first quarter of 1997.
- ME97/5.6: Midday Express.
